news.text: Bengaluru Warriors has been created in India.
Kerala Blasters FC has been created in India.
Athul FC has been created in England.
Galaxy fc 0-2 Willem II. Matchday revenue ₹4.4M.
Galaxy fc 2-3 CF Estrela da Amadora. Matchday revenue ₹4.4M.
Galaxy fc 0-3 Middlesbrough FC. Matchday revenue ₹4.4M.
Galaxy fc 0-1 UAE Rovers 6. Matchday revenue ₹4.4M.
Galaxy fc 2-2 Al Tai. Matchday revenue ₹4.4M.
Galaxy fc has been created in England with a full 16-man squad.
FC Barcelona hired Pep Guardiola (Possession specialist) on a 3-season contract.

managers.name: Pep Guardiola
managers.title: Tiki-Taka Mastermind
managers.bio: Pioneer of fluid positional play, inverted full-backs, and relentless ball retention.

managers.name: Carlo Ancelotti
managers.title: The European Master
managers.bio: Master of player psychology, calm authority, and devastating transitional moments.

managers.name: Jurgen Klopp
managers.title: Heavy Metal Gegenpresser
managers.bio: Demands relentless intensity, suffocating high-pressing traps, and volcanic passion.

managers.name: Mikel Arteta
managers.title: Positional Play Perfectionist
managers.bio: Dominant territorial control, suffocating set-piece dominance, and strict discipline.

managers.name: Xabi Alonso
managers.title: The Invincible Architect
managers.bio: Surgical tactical symmetry, high-pressing overload, and wing-back domination.

managers.name: Zinedine Zidane
managers.title: Galáctico Whisperer
managers.bio: Effortless big-game aura, clutch Champions League mastery, and midfield balance.

managers.name: Diego Simeone
managers.title: Cholismo High Priest
managers.bio: Granite-solid low block, fierce emotional intensity, and blood-and-sweat defending.

managers.name: Jose Mourinho
managers.title: The Special One
managers.bio: Pragmatic master of mind games, defensive resilience, and ruthless counter-punches.

managers.name: Hansi Flick
managers.title: Hyper-Direct Pressing General
managers.bio: Blistering vertical velocity, suffocating offside lines, and ruthless attacking volume.

managers.name: Luis Enrique
managers.title: Vertical Possession Maestro
managers.bio: Relentless dynamic passing, wide 1v1 wingers, and bold attacking ideology.

managers.name: Antonio Conte
managers.title: Drill-Sergeant Perfectionist
managers.bio: Iron-fisted physical conditioning, robotic automation patterns, and wing-back warfare.

managers.name: Ruben Amorim
managers.title: High-Line Counter Specialist
managers.bio: Modern 3-4-3 pressing and explosive diagonal transitions.

managers.name: Julian Nagelsmann
managers.title: Tactical Prodigy
managers.bio: Asymmetrical pressing shapes, high tactical versatility, and speed of thought.

managers.name: Unai Emery
managers.title: European Cup Specialist
managers.bio: Meticulous video preparation, compact mid-block traps, and lightning counters.

managers.name: Simone Inzaghi
managers.title: 3-5-2 Transition Genius
managers.bio: Master of sweeping counter-attacks, fluid center-back overlaps, and cup knockout magic.

managers.name: Lionel Scaloni
managers.title: World Cup Champion
managers.bio: Adaptable tactical pragmatism, defensive solidarity, and player brotherhood.

managers.name: Cesare Marchetti
managers.title: The Grand Strategist
managers.bio: Veteran Italian tactician revered for unbreakable backlines and stoic defensive structure.

managers.name: Henrik Lindqvist
managers.title: Nordic Data Architect
managers.bio: Analytical Danish coach who pioneered algorithmic positional overloads.

managers.name: Gonzalo "El Halcón" Romero
managers.title: South American Firebrand
managers.bio: Roaring touchline intensity, demanding non-stop forward pressing and rapid tackles.

managers.name: Cedric Beaumont
managers.title: French Transition Artist
managers.bio: Turns organized mid-blocks into lightning-fast 3-pass breakaway goals.

managers.name: Stefan Petrovic
managers.title: Balkan Strongman
managers.bio: Disciplined, physically imposing side dominating second balls and aerial crosses.

managers.name: Tiago Barreto
managers.title: Iberian Passmaster
managers.bio: Smooth technical passing combinations and intelligent positional rotation.

managers.name: Babatunde Adeleke
managers.title: The Energy Dynamo
managers.bio: West African high-workrate tactician whose teams out-run and out-fight all opponents.

managers.name: Alonso De la Cruz
managers.title: Aerial Battle Commander
managers.bio: Dominates lower-tier scraps through physicality, target-man headers, and set pieces.

managers.name: Javier Solano
managers.title: Technical Futsal Guru
managers.bio: Teaches fearless short passing and composed escape routes under heavy lower-league pressure.

managers.name: Dmitri Voronin
managers.title: The Iron Curtain
managers.bio: Concedes the fewest goals in the league through disciplined, resolute low-block defending.

managers.name: Siddharth Rao
managers.title: The Modern Visionary
managers.bio: Methodical coach renowned for transforming modest squads into attractive passing machines.

managers.name: Marco Valenti
managers.title: The Pragmatic Hunter
managers.bio: Master of 1-0 away wins, disciplined defensive shields, and ruthless counter-strikes.

managers.name: Rajesh "Iron Wall" Nair
managers.title: Kerala Wall Organizer
managers.bio: Rugged lower-league hero famous for heroic goal-line clearances, warrior spirit, and set-piece headers.

managers.name: Kenji Takahashi
managers.title: Stamina & Discipline Guru
managers.bio: Tireless running schedules, synchronised pressing triggers, and relentless work ethic.

managers.name: Viktor Dahl
managers.title: Zonal Fortress Builder
managers.bio: Swedish defensive disciplinarian who constructs impenetrable compact banks of four.

managers.name: Callum MacLeod
managers.title: Scottish Pitch Battler
managers.bio: Loves muddy pitches, fearless slide tackles, and direct route-one deliveries to a target man.

managers.name: Mateo Morales
managers.title: Grassroots Youth Mentor
managers.bio: Patient academy coach who rapidly develops young talent and instills confident ball retention.

managers.name: Lucas "Tiki" Santana
managers.title: Favela Maestro
managers.bio: Teaches youngsters silky touch and composure even in physical lower-league dogfights.

managers.name: Kwame Mensah
managers.title: High-Octane Fighter
managers.bio: Demands relentless work-rate, fierce determination, and lightning wing turnovers.

managers.name: Liam O'Connor
managers.title: Promotion Scrap Veteran
managers.bio: No-nonsense gaffer who knows every scrap, trick, and long-throw tactic in the book.

managers.name: Sunil Mukherjee
managers.title: The Giant Slayer
managers.bio: Specialist in shocking higher-ranked sides with disciplined compactness and rapid breaks.

managers.name: Arthur Pendelton
managers.title: Old-School Gaffer
managers.bio: Traditional English gaffer who demands pride, crunching tackles, and 90 minutes of pure grit.
